fusions.name: Dunking Stool
fusions.desc: Dunks the target in a conjured mesh, dealing 14 damage and leaving it [Stunned] for 1.2 seconds, [Soaked] for 5 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Skipping Sinkers
fusions.desc: Skips 3 mesh weights across the ground at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 35% chance to leave its target [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Runs Through the Mesh
fusions.desc: Lets up to 5 conditions run out of you through the mesh and restores 8 health.

fusions.name: Buoyed Step

riders.text: you move 10% faster while you are on it
and your dodge chance is 8% higher while you are on it

fusions.desc: A line of floats holds you up: you walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 10% faster on it, and from silver your dodge chance on it rises by 8%.
